name: Uíge
pointBasis: UN WUP2025 population-weighted settlement locator; not a municipal boundary or parcel-coverage claim.
registryBasis: Angola's IGCA is evidenced as the national geographic and cadastral authority, and the MINFIN property portal exposes property registration workflows with province/municipality location fields. No Uíge-local registry office, public parcel viewer, or anonymous citywide parcel geometry endpoint was verified.
technicalBlocker: No anonymous source-native response containing a safe parcel identifier, complete polygon, schema, and CRS was verified. The public MINFIN pages expose authenticated/session-oriented property registration and taxpayer/property searches; IGCA material describes a planned or existing integrated cadastre/web consultation capability but did not expose a public endpoint in the reviewed pages.
scopeLimits: National cadastral authority and a public property-registration workflow were reviewed separately from parcel geometry. No owner, address, contact, titleholder, tax/account, or other unsafe data was requested or retained. No citywide or countrywide parcel completeness is asserted.
remainingUncertainty: The exact parcel at the preserved WUP point, any anonymous IGCA or Uíge municipal viewer/API, native parcel-ID field, CRS, and citywide coverage remain unverified. A map extent miss, unavailable route, login wall, or zero exact-point hit would not establish citywide absence.
nextStep: Serial review may pursue an official anonymous IGCA/municipal geometry-only route if one is published, validating CRS, parcel semantics, coverage, and source-native IDs before integration.

queries.query: Uíge Angola cadastro predial mapa cadastral parcelas portal oficial
queries.result: Resultados oficiais em português confirmaram o Instituto Geográfico e Cadastral de Angola (IGCA) e o fluxo MINFIN de cadastro de património/imposto predial. O portal público consultado requer dados de contribuinte/imóvel para pesquisa ou inscrição e não publicou uma camada anónima de polígonos cadastrais para Uíge.
queries.executionMethod: Pesquisa fresca separada em português, seguida de consulta de páginas oficiais e requisições GET públicas limitadas.

officialSources.observation: Official MINFIN-hosted document describes IGCA as the body responsible for national geographic and cadastral policy/execution and discusses creating urban cadastral bases. It does not expose a public Uíge parcel endpoint.

Anonymous GET returned HTTP 200 HTML. The page exposes a PrimeFaces form with province/municipality/commune location controls and a Google map point-selection widget. It is a registration workflow, not an anonymous parcel-polygon service; no form submission or unsafe field query was made.
Anonymous GET returned HTTP 200 HTML with empty results and fields for taxpayer/property identifiers. It is identifier-based and exposes no citywide parcel geometry or safe public feature schema.

geometryDecision.exactWupPointTest: No parcel containment test was completed. Exact WUP point [-7.60700348087086, 15.0520154227901] was preserved and not shifted.
